messages:
elaine-partnerships: Heads-up — we just hit repeated OOMs on MI300 in eu-central when running long-context LLM evals. Symptoms look like a KV cache growth bug rather than model size. Vendor/partners looped in. We need a short mitigation plan (marketplace SKU fallback + SI integration test window + announcement cadence) before next week's customer demos.

ken-eng: Ack. Can you paste a minimal repro and which model/seq-len?

elaine-partnerships: Repro is with `redwood/rebel-13b@v3` at seq 8192 with batching. Instance: `mi300-eu-02`, logs show steady mem usage until spike then OOM. Snip: ``ERROR: GPU OOM during KV-append at step 542``.

sam-platform: For mitigation we can route traffic for the eu region to H100/H200 variants for that model tag. Propose temporary routing policy `hw-fallback-eu` + canary.

jules-cloud: Need to map marketplace SKUs so customers on the marketplace see the fallback without manual change. Example mapping we can push:
```
marketplace_sku_map:
  rebel-13b:
    eu: [H100-XL, H200-STD]
    global-fallback: [H100-XL]
```
We can push a non-breaking listing edit that updates the suggested hardware.

ken-eng: Also considering a soft-fallback inside the serving runtime: prefer H100-compatible kernel when `seq_len > 4096` for that model id. That avoids changing user-visible SKUs for power users.

vendor-mi300: Thanks for the report, @elaine-partnerships. We're reproducing against our internal infra. Tentative patch ETA: 72 hours. We can provide a driver build v0.9.7-rc1 for testing tomorrow EOD. Recommend setting `gpu_mem_guard=0.85` in the meantime to keep processes alive.

vendor-gaudi: We're checking whether Gaudi images have similar KV cache heuristics; no immediate regression observed on our side, but happy to run extended seq tests. ETA for test report: 24h.

sam-platform: To be concrete, plan suggestion:
1) Create routing policy `hw-fallback-eu` (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%)
2) Marketplace listing non-breaking update that surfaces fallback SKUs to EU customers
3) SI integration window: Thu-Fri 02:00-08:00 UTC for partners to run compatibility tests
4) Customer comms: internal note + embargoed advisory if patch is delayed beyond 72h

ken-eng: Approve. Add a config snippet for the runtime flag we can toggle:
```json
{
  "routing_policies": {
    "hw-fallback-eu": {
      "match": {"region": "eu-central", "model_id": "rebel-13b"},
      "fallback_hosts": ["h100-eu-*","h200-eu-*"],
      "canary_pct": 5
    }
  }
}
```

jules-cloud: SI teams — please confirm availability for the Thu-Fri window. I can hold marketplace change until we confirm. @vendor-mi300 any constraints on the RC build we should note for the SI runs?

vendor-mi300: RC1 is binary-only, no infra changes. Should be safe for canary. Recommend not using quantized variants for the canary — use native FP16.

elaine-partnerships: Good call. Also, ops: please create an incident record and a short runbook we can follow for rollbacks. Include the prod -> dedicated traffic step.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-345 for "MI300 EU KV-cache growth / OOM". Runbook doc: https://internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-345 (private).

sam-platform: I'll draft the marketplace PR and routing change; will link here when ready.

ken-eng: One more ask — add a perf regression eval against H100 fallback for cost delta. We need to tell customers expected latency/cost impact if routed.

jules-cloud: Noted. I'll coordinate with finance to estimate token cost delta for fallback.

vendor-gaudi: If you want us to run extended seq tests against Gaudi for parity, send a commit hash and we will run 24h stress.

elaine-partnerships: Thanks all. Action owners: @sam-platform routing & marketplace PR, @ken-eng runtime toggle & perf eval, @jules-cloud SI window + marketplace timing, @vendor-mi300 vendor RC + test report, @vendor-gaudi extended tests. We'll reconvene after vendor RC or in 48h. :thumbsup:
